verdict.rationale: Bugbot docs claim it reads prior PR comments (top-level and inline) to 'avoid duplicate suggestions and build on prior feedback,' which is the only mechanism resembling learning from past reviewer interactions, and BUGBOT.md lets teams codify guidelines to suppress unwanted rule categories. However, there is no documented mechanism specifically triggered by a developer pushing back/rejecting a comment that causes Bugbot to stop repeating that exact feedback — the 'avoid duplicates' feature is about not repeating the same bug flag, not about learning from developer disagreement. Missing for 10: an explicit reject/dismiss feedback loop, evidence that dismissed comments are remembered across future PRs, and independent confirmation that pushback measurably reduces repeat false positives.
